entries.title: Jeremiah 20:1
segments: ¶And Pashur the son of Immer, the priest--and he was chief officer in the house of Jehovah--heard Jeremiah prophesy these things.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:2
segments: And Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in the house of Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:3
segments: And it came to pass the next day, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks; and Jeremiah said unto him, Jehovah hath not called thy name Pashur, but Magor-missabib.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:4
segments: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I make thee a terror to thyself, and to all thy friends; and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and thine eyes shall see [it]; and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall smite them with the sword.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:5
segments: And, I will give all the wealth of this city, and all its gains, and all its precious things, and all the treasures of the kings of Judah, will I give into the hand of their enemies; and they shall make them a prey, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:6
segments: And thou, Pashur, and all that dwell in thy house shall go into captivity; and thou shalt come to Babylon, and there thou shalt die, and there thou shalt be buried, thou and all thy friends to whom thou hast prophesied falsehood.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:7
segments: ¶Jehovah, thou hast enticed me, and I was enticed; thou hast laid hold of me, and hast prevailed; I am become a derision the whole day: every one mocketh me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:8
segments: For as oft as I speak, I cry out; I proclaim violence and spoil; for the word of Jehovah is become unto me a reproach and a derision all the day.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:9
segments: And I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name: but it was in my heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones; and I became wearied with holding in, and I could not.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:10
segments: For I have heard the defaming of many, terror on every side: Report, and we will report it. All my familiars are watching for my stumbling: Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him; and we shall take our revenge on him.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:11
segments: But Jehovah is with me as a mighty terrible one; therefore my persecutors shall stumble and shall not prevail; they shall be greatly ashamed, for they have not prospered: it shall be an everlasting confusion that shall not be forgotten.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:12
segments: And thou, Jehovah of hosts, who triest the righteous, who seest the reins and the heart, let me see thy vengeance on them; for unto thee have I revealed my cause.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:13
segments: Sing ye unto Jehovah, praise Jehovah, for he hath delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:14
segments: ¶Cursed be the day wherein I was born; let not the day wherein my mother bore me be blessed!

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:15
segments: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto thee; making him very glad!

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:16
segments: And let that man be as the cities which Jehovah overthrew, and repented not; and let him hear a cry in the morning, and a shouting at noonday,

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:17
segments: because he slew me not from the womb. Or would that my mother had been my grave, and her womb always great [with me]!

entries.title: Jeremiah 20:18
segments: Wherefore came I forth from the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed in shame?
